entities.summary: Aaron David Miller is an American Middle East analyst, author, and negotiator. He is a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, focusing on U.S. foreign policy. He previously was vice president for new initiatives at the Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars, and has been an advisor to both Republican and Democratic secretaries of state. He is a Global Affairs Analyst for CNN. Aaron David Miller was a political leaders from Cleveland (b. 1949-03-25, Cleveland). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace and advisor to multiple U.S. secretaries of state, Aaron David Miller has played a significant role in shaping U.S. Middle East policy, with implications for regional stability and global geopolitics.
